review_method: Complete decoded-frame coverage through exact pixel identity with the previously inspected prefix plus direct inspection of all remaining chronological frame sheets; not a claim of real-time playback viewing.
findings: Continuous pickup/rise and genuine alternating walking retain the box. The preserved carry shows reduced object/palm wobble. COM shift and foot pivot settle into stationary support. Lowering remains visibly compliant and contains local object rocking; forks fold before supported release. Terrain supports the box before physical palm/thumb opening. Both hands separate, withdraw upward/back, and remain clear while the robot settles into a stable crouch and the box remains on terrain. No ejection, airborne release, forbidden contact, fall, or recontact is visible.
grasp_review_note: Walking rocking remains bounded at 9.09/7.02 degrees; fixed box-material-point tangential excursions are 8.01/5.03 mm. Contact and pose histories retain physical hand support. The new support transition adds only 1.77/1.80 degrees of palm-relative motion, with 0.53/1.87 mm local excursions. Placement object angular acceleration regresses and is reported; zero slip and uniform improvement across all phases are not claimed.
